stories.title: Russia Hits Ukrainian Infrastructure Ahead of Abu Dhabi Talks

reports.text: [United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870550) reported that Russian and Ukrainian officials held talks in Abu Dhabi mediated by the US, focusing on security guarantees while territorial issues remain a core dispute.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-strikes-cut-russias-oil-refining-capacity-by-30-reuters-reports/) reported that Ukrainian strikes cut Russia's oil refining capacity by 30% according to Reuters.
[RIA Novosti](https://ria.ru/20261110/zelenskij-2130732043.html) (state-media) reported that President Zelensky called the first day of negotiations in Abu Dhabi constructive.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/10/8062179/) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the trilateral negotiations in the UAE were productive and that a significant amount of work remains.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-abu-dhabi-war-peace-talks/33894644.html) reported that Ukrainian and Russian negotiators wrapped up the first of two days of US-brokered talks aimed at ending the war.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-11/ukraine-russia-talks-abu-dhabi/107371042) reported that envoys from Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington D.C. discussed security guarantees, territorial concessions, and a Europe-wide security framework at their first meeting.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-peace-talks-drone-strike-b3082131.html) reported that U.S. officials admitted a lot of work remains to be done for peace after the first day of Kyiv-Moscow talks in Abu Dhabi.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261110-ukraine-peace-talks-in-abu-dhabi-to-test-russia-s-willingness-to-negotiate) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky coordinated positions with European leaders ahead of the United States-mediated peace talks with Russia in Abu Dhabi.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/russia-says-it-shot-down-155-ukrainian-drones-over-various-regions/) reported that Russia's Defence Ministry stated air defence systems intercepted and destroyed 155 Ukrainian drones over various parts of Russia overnight.
[United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870376) reported that the first day of US-led talks between Ukraine and Russia concluded in Abu Dhabi.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/rubio-calls-russia-ukraine-talks-in-abu-dhabi-very-productive-says-goal-is-to-include-europe-101794318845471.html) reported that US-led Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi concluded with negotiations set to resume.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/leaders-urge-new-european-security-framework-as-russia-ukraine-talks-continue/) reported that US-mediated negotiations to end the war between Russia and Ukraine began in Abu Dhabi.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-09-russia-and-ukraine-showing-flexibility-on-territory-us-official-says/) reported that both Russia and Ukraine are showing some flexibility privately on the possible exchange of territory ahead of US-mediated talks in Washington.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/russia-ukraine-resume-abu-dhabi-talks-major-hurdles-remain) reported that Russia and Ukraine resumed US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi while disputes over territory and security guarantees remain.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202449/%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B8%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%86%D8%B3%D9%8A-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86/) reported that France's foreign minister confirmed representatives from Britain, Germany, and France would attend the Abu Dhabi talks, differing from the Kremlin.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/rusia-y-ucrania-mantienen-casi-4-horas-de-conversaciones-mediadas-por-eeuu-en-abu-dabi_0_rti0SN3wI3.html) reported that Russia and Ukraine held nearly four hours of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi to seek an agreement to end the conflict.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/emiratos-espera-fin-de-la-guerra-en-ucrania-recibe-tercera-ronda-de-negociaciones-en-abu-dabi/) reported that the United Arab Emirates hosted the third round of negotiations in Abu Dhabi, covering security guarantees, a potential ceasefire, prisoner exchanges, and economic reconstruction.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/10/nx-s1-6034616/kushner-and-witkoff-renew-peace-talks-to-end-war-between-russia-and-ukraine) reported that President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/10/ukraine-russia-war-us-talks-abu-dhabi-europe-latest-news-updates) reported that US-led talks in Abu Dhabi broke up after four hours and were expected to resume the next day as US officials sought a final end to the Russia-Ukraine war.

[BBC World](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqpvgvrpjvv8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that delegations from Kyiv, Washington, and Moscow were in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-us-mediated-talks-on-ending-russia-ukraine-war-begin-in-abu-dhabi) reported that three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the US opened in the United Arab Emirates as Washington made another push to end the war.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNeV9jM2c1bUNuM1JEalVybmVybVZfM1docm42TjZ6QWdiNFZmeWItTndYZjk0dExkMUhnQzlLWTRGWDJuVVoxR2NBMlQtZW1nY1owdE5IaWM5SVBoTXp3NjdROWhRcjh3Z3A5SFl6VExpWGJ2WFl5TnZ0UUxQamgxcXdUNE1BSER5cUdqVVdwc3pJcWYzc1dGNmlmS1FkdmJMb1o3T282eU9FMDM1ZWw4VURkQ3BXQUJqdEVkUGZndl9vSTNWWGc?oc=5) reported that a delegation source said Russia sees a European security framework as the main thrust of the Ukraine talks.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3373976/russia-ukraine-hold-us-backed-talks-first-time-february) reported that Russian and Ukrainian officials met for their first US-brokered talks since February.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-brokered-talks-are-set-to-start-in-abu-dhabi-to-discuss-ukraine-russia-peace-deal/article71685183.ece) reported that US-mediated talks on ending the war between Russia and Ukraine began in Abu Dhabi, focusing on security guarantees.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/10/talks-on-ending-russia-ukraine-war-begin-in-abu-dhabi/) reported that three-way talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States opened in the United Arab Emirates as Washington renewed its push to end the war.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-it-s-a-farce-hegseth-slams-impeachment-effort) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a move to impeach him by a Republican lawmaker as a farce and a political stunt.

[United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870543) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth called the impeachment initiative a farce and stated that attacking Iran was the right decision after Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced an impeachment motion.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/hegsetu-preti-opoziv-evo-sta-mu-se-stavlja-na-teret-prvo-obracanje-ministra-odbrane/jkwd2m4) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth said at a press conference in the Pentagon that the impeachment initiative is based on political disagreements.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/politics/article/3373990/hegseth-calls-impeachment-bid-farce-he-defends-iran-war) reported that US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth called an impeachment bill against him a farce while defending the ongoing war in Iran and air strikes.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/house-set-to-vote-on-pete-hegseth-impeachment-resolution-today-says-thomas-massie-101794322788233.html) reported that Congressman Thomas Massie stated the House will first consider a motion to stop the impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pete-hegseth-pentagon-briefing-us-defense-chief-dismisses-impeachment-move-as-political-spectacle-101794316626350.html) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed the impeachment move as a political spectacle and stated he stands beside every operation in the Iran war.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/alvo-de-impeachment-secretario-de-defesa-de-trump-chama-processo-de-espetaculo-politico.shtml) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called the impeachment process initiated against him a political spectacle.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/hegseth-claims-iran-victory-in-press-conference-as-war-and-impeachment-fight-continue) reported that Pete Hegseth defended the Iran war and drug-boat strikes as Representative Thomas Massie's impeachment articles head toward a possible House vote.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/09/us/politics/hegseth-impeachment-massie.html) reported that Representative Thomas Massie set in motion a vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth that must occur by Wednesday.

[US Department of Defense](https://www.war.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/4644710/secretary-of-war-pete-hegseth-orders-sweeping-overhaul-of-military-education-to/) reported that Secretary of War Pete Hegseth directed a comprehensive overhaul of the Department's higher military service colleges.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/10/donald-trump-pete-hegseth-thomas-massie-republicans-iran-war-impeachment-midterms-latest-news-updates) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed an impeachment effort from Congressman Thomas Massie as a personal manifesto driven by ego.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/10/hegseth-promises-to-defend-warriors-as-he-faces-impeachment?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth criticized an attempt by Representative Thomas Massie to impeach him.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261110-live-pentagon-chief-pete-hegseth-calls-move-to-impeach-him-a-farce) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth called moves to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a farce that would fail.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/10/pete-hegseth-impeachment-massie) reported that Thomas Massie accused the US defense secretary of illegally waging war without congressional authorization and abusing his powers.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043549/embattled-pentagon-chief-slams-impeachment-effort-as-farce) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth denounced a push to impeach him as a farce and defended his military record.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/pentagon-chief-hegseth-calls-moves-to-impeach-him-a-farce-that-will-fail/article71686563.ece) reported that Pete Hegseth called moves to impeach him a farce that will fail, following US Representative Thomas Massie introducing eight articles of impeachment.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/defence-secretary-pete-hegseth-thomas-massie-8-articles-of-impeachment-filed-united-states-war-power-resolution/article71684991.ece) reported that Representative Thomas Massie, backed by lawmakers including Ro Khanna, introduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/republican-thomas-massie-of-kentucky-launches-bid-to-impeach-defense-secretary-pete-hegseth/article71685083.ece) reported that Republican Thomas Massie of Kentucky launched a bid to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, stating his actions amounted to high crimes and misdemeanors.

reports.text: [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261108-ex-army-chief-eisenkot-given-first-chance-to-form-government-in-israel) reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

According to [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-former-israeli-prime-minister-barak-urges-eisenkot-to-accelerate-government-formation/), former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government.
